description: This is a Java source file that implements a class Sum for computing the sum of numerical values in a dataset. It extends an abstract class for univariate statistics, supports incremental calculation, and includes methods for evaluating sums over arrays with optional weighting.

classes.name: Sum
classes.description: Implements a summation of dataset values, supporting incremental updates, evaluation over array segments, and copying between instances.

methods.name: Sum
methods.description: Default constructor initializing sum and count to zero.

methods.name: Sum
methods.description: Copy constructor creating a new Sum instance from an existing one.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Adds a new value to the current sum and increments the count.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the current sum of values.

methods.name: getN
methods.description: Returns the number of values added.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the sum and count to zero.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Calculates the sum of a subset of array values.

methods.name: evaluate (weighted)
methods.description: Calculates the weighted sum over a subset of array values with weights.

methods.name: evaluate (full array)
methods.description: Calculates the sum of the entire array.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Sum instance.
